notes.title: In-game locations overwiev.
notes.notes:
In addition to the world map, the player will be able to travel through detailed levels.
Depending on the place on the map, it can be wilderness, province, or one of bigger settlements.
We created scenes for the needs of random events, quests, and for each of the cities.
The player can explore occupied cities incognito.

The construction of the levels reflects the social structure in occupied Alaska - there are containers of colonizers and slums occupied by the American population. In order to defend against marauders and guerrillas, the settlements are fortified by invasion forces.

notes.title: SETTLEMENT CONCEPT
notes.notes:
In world of HeatWave, cities of Alaska witness a military invasion combined with civilian colonization.
People are harassed and displaced from their homes.
They find refuge in the slums formed around the settlements of new inhabitants.

How do you like our concept of one of these towns? Do you have any suggestions for improvement?
